summary: Verified DiscoverPage filter button safe-area fix (iter 29). Source code assertions all pass: filter button uses top:calc(var(--safe-top,24px)+8px), z-[15], stopPropagation onClick, w-10 h-10. Swipe counter (top+8px), photo indicators (top+2px), verified badge (top+36px), and city label (top+12px) all use var(--safe-top,24px). City filter sheet has z-[80] with data-testid='city-filter-sheet'. Backend health 200 and /api/discover/{user_id} returns 200. Frontend UI test (390x844 mobile viewport) confirmed filter button is visible (box y=14, w=40, h=40), zIndex=15, pointerEvents=auto. Real mouse click opens the city-filter sheet (z-index 80), filter-mumbai option is clickable, and filter applies successfully. --safe-top on web preview resolves to 0px (fallback branch = 24px not applied because var is defined as 0px by capacitor plugin — verify on Android device where the plugin sets a non-zero value).

issues: On web preview --safe-top is 0px (set by Capacitor plugin as an empty/zero value), so the fallback of 24px in calc() does not apply — the button sits at y=14. On Android the plugin should set --safe-top to the actual status-bar inset (recommend verifying on device that --safe-top > 0). If plugin fails to inject, fallback of 24px still works because CSS var would be undefined.

action_items: Daily Reward modal auto-shows on every discover load and blocks the filter button visually (though not click-through). Consider throttling reward modal (once per session/day) so it doesn't overlap the filter UX.
Verify on real Android device that Capacitor safe-area plugin sets --safe-top to the actual status bar height (e.g., 24-32px) — the fix depends on this.
critical_code_review_comments: Filter button click handler uses e.stopPropagation() correctly to prevent card swipe gestures from firing.
All overlay elements consistently use var(--safe-top, 24px) — good defensive fallback if Capacitor plugin fails to inject the variable.
